definitions.gloss: certainty; reliability; sureness; degree of certainty
definitions.explanation: The quality of being certain or reliable — the extent to which something can be counted on to happen or be true. Used when evaluating predictions, plans, methods, or outcomes.

examples.japanese: {確実性|かくじつせい}が{高|たか}い{方法|ほうほう}を{選|えら}ぶ。
examples.english: Choose the method with higher certainty.

examples.japanese: {予測|よそく}の{確実性|かくじつせい}を{高|たか}めるためにデータを{増|ふ}やした。
examples.english: We increased the data to improve the reliability of predictions.

examples.japanese: {速|はや}さより{確実性|かくじつせい}を{優先|ゆうせん}して{手術|しゅじゅつ}の{方針|ほうしん}を{立|た}てた。
examples.english: We set the surgical approach prioritizing certainty over speed.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {確実性|かくじつせい}が{高|たか}い: high certainty; highly reliable
- {確実性|かくじつせい}が{低|ひく}い: low certainty
- {確実性|かくじつせい}を{高|たか}める: to improve certainty
- {確実性|かくじつせい}を{重視|じゅうし}する: to emphasize reliability

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {正確性|せいかくせい}: accuracy — how close to the true value, not how dependable
- {信頼性|しんらいせい}: trustworthiness — reliability of a person or system over time
